note: The test field consumer is always non-null when getProcessor runs: toInputStream (used by test/testSame/testAndReturnResult) and runWithoutExpected (used only by shadowAsts_featuresSetOnMainAstScript and includesShadowedCode) each assign a fresh lambda `ast -> result[0] = ast` over a new TypedAst[1] immediately before calling the harness. Fix-2 (2026-10-07): the lambda is rebuilt verbatim inside helper SerializeAndDeserializeAstTest_Helpers (method toInputStream or runWithoutExpected, selected by the recorded test method), so the replayed field is a real lambda capturing a TypedAst[1], like the recorded one; the holder is shared through {"once":"consumerHolder"} (one consumer per hooked call, as in the test) and every case opts in to testFieldsAfter on it. Replay therefore compares the recorded post-call consumer dump in every record: the captured TypedAst[1] (null before the pass runs) with the whole serialized TypedAst message in the neutral protobuf encoding of the v7 records (harness round 2, D-017 item 2; FORMAT.md "Neutral encodings": pools, externs summary, runtime_library_to_inject and each LazyAst's script decoded into its AstNode tree). classMap maps the recorded lambda name SerializeAndDeserializeAstTest$$Lambda to the helper's lambda name (replay applies classMap in reverse to the dump; no recorded value is decoded through it). Under --noop-processor or the class-level no-op of SerializeTypedAstPass the consumer never receives a TypedAst, so every record fails with a testFieldsAfter difference (no longer vacuous). Three records (index 5, 6, 58) read their input from a file on disk (SourceFileProto file_on_disk or zip_entry); the record's inputs hold only name, code and kind, so replay serializes a preloaded SourceFile and their consumer dump cannot match: they are listed under unrepresentable below (excluded from (a), counted in (e)). Not in the record: everything the test's follow-up run(...) checks on the AST that TypedAstDeserializer rebuilds in a fresh compiler (tree and JSDoc equality with the expected code, feature sets, AstValidator, colors, original names, source files, source maps, shadow ASTs, DeserializedAst fields). Those round-trip checks are listed in corpus/unit/rust_unit_tests/SerializeAndDeserializeAstTest.md; all 75 flagged methods are classified in corpus/unit/postcall/SerializeAndDeserializeAstTest.json (classify round 2, batch 3). includeTypes, resolveSourceMapAnnotations, parseInlineSourceMaps and checkJsDocEquality are read only by that follow-up. runtimeLibraries is decoded to an ImmutableList (ImmutableList.of() from setUp, or ['base','es6/string'] in includesRuntimeLibraryPaths).
